hypothesis: Maintain the 64-action capacity but make up to eight slots task-local and goal-aware: promote canonical two-piece BRICS macrofragments extracted from above-median oracle-scored molecules into the lowest-use original vocabulary slots, so one sampled start or attachment action can reuse a scored connected motif that previously required two primitive fragment choices.
method_thesis: Decompose the allowed unlabeled corpus into a fixed vocabulary of chemically sanitized, attachment-labelled fragments and use its reconstruction trajectories only to behavior-clone a task-agnostic graph policy. In each independent objective session, start complete constructions from a sampled vocabulary fragment and repeatedly sample a three-part categorical action: an open attachment site on the current partial graph, a fragment, and a compatible attachment site on that fragment, with an explicit stop action and valence-checked transitions. Canonicalize completed graphs and submit only fresh valid unique assemblies in the evaluator-announced batch; the vocabulary is a combinatorial action alphabet, not a pool of whole-molecule candidates. Put the scored initial molecules when representable and every subsequently generated trajectory into a task-local replay buffer, assign the observed oracle score only at the terminal transition, and update corrected twin soft-Q critics, the stochastic actor, and its entropy temperature from uniformly replayed transitions. The next molecules are sampled directly from the updated actor, so no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or screened and no finite molecular candidate set is enumerated. Off-policy trajectory reuse lets each scarce terminal observation train many partial-graph decisions, while maximum-entropy action sampling resists early policy collapse; both serve the sole benchmark target of a stronger final Top-1 on each session.

activation_observables.measurement: For every Objective Session, emit a receipt for each promoted slot containing its canonical two-piece macrofragment, source molecule score and within-feedback rank, replaced original fragment, open-port labels, heavy-atom count, and synchronized actor-buffer state. For every suggestion batch report the number and fraction of emitted trajectories that selected at least one currently promoted slot and the cumulative primitive attachment decisions compressed by those selections. Compare the session totals with the Parent value of zero task-local promotions, zero promoted-action uses, and zero compressed decisions; activation requires at least one eligible above-median macrofragment to be promoted and subsequently used in an emitted trajectory.
activation_observables.name: goal_ranked_macrofragment_action_adoption

applicability_conditions: Task-local initial or adaptive feedback must contain score variation and at least one sanitizable molecule with a BRICS cut whose joined adjacent pieces form a novel proper subgraph with one to four remaining compatible ports; the Parent observed many distinct adaptive scores on every task.

The useful objective signal must be partly attributable to a connected two-piece BRICS motif and transferable when that motif is reused as a construction action; objectives requiring non-BRICS rearrangements, ring-closing actions, or disconnected jumps remain outside the claim.

The replacement remains bounded to eight of 64 slots and preserves the prepared actor dimensions, the inherited compatibility relation, validity and valence masks, uniform replay, twin-soft-Q and entropy objectives, direct sampling, and all evaluator protocol invariants.

A promoted macrofragment is an attachment-labelled subgraph action extracted only from molecules already scored in the current Objective Session; it is not a whole-molecule candidate, corpus retrieval result, extra oracle query, or cross-task memory.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism is falsified if eligible above-median scored molecules produce no admitted novel two-piece macrofragment, if admitted macrofragments are never selected in any emitted trajectory, or if a promotion receipt shows that the sampled slot still carries the replaced fragment's canonical structure, port descriptors, or action features rather than the promoted motif.
research_intent.implementation_change: At Objective Session initialization and after each observe, rank only the task-local scored molecules already supplied by the evaluator, enumerate their adjacent BRICS-piece pairs, and retain novel connected proper subgraphs with one to four compatible open ports and bounded heavy-atom size. Admit at most two initial macrofragments and then at most one per feedback boundary until eight total slots have been replaced; keep vocabulary tensor shapes fixed, choose the least-used unreplaced corpus slot, rebuild that slot's fragment and port descriptors, and initialize its actor embedding from descriptor-nearest retained corpus actions. Record promotion provenance and count promoted-slot use in generated trajectories while leaving behavior cloning artifacts, masks, SAC replay and losses, terminal reward placement, canonicalization, duplicate rejection, batch filling, and terminal shutdown unchanged.

research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Algorithm Node n-a5a9c7e8871a established that the fixed 64-fragment action vocabulary represented 0 of 50 initial oracle observations and yielded only 10 complete corpus reconstruction routes, even though it filled every proposal batch with aggregate novel-valid yield 0.9843856076035302. Operational Parent n-ccfe8deb016a retained that same preparation and proposal mechanism and scored only 0.18878509058328807 on median_2 and 0.09619409434884696 on sitagliptin_mpo. The limiting behavior is therefore not failure to emit valid molecules, but a coarse static action alphabet that cannot expose task-relevant multi-fragment motifs from the scored molecules it observes.

applicability_conditions: The required score variation and extractability conditions held on all five formal sessions. Every one of the 150 initial or adaptive refresh receipts reported positive within-cohort score variation and five strictly above-median molecules; the admission-capable refreshes exposed aggregate eligible-novel-candidate counts of 81 for zaleplon_mpo, 83 for deco_hop, 54 for drd2_docking, 82 for median_2, and 75 for sitagliptin_mpo, and every task admitted eight motifs.

Task locality is directly supported: all 40 receipt source molecule/score pairs were found in the exact ten-entry initial or immediately preceding adaptive cohort for that same objective, with exact reconstructed ranks and no cross-task source. The code has no corpus scoring, whole-molecule retrieval, extra oracle query, or cross-session promotion memory.

The bounded replacement assumptions held in the formal execution: each task retained vocabulary size 64 and compatibility-pair count 46, replaced exactly eight distinct previously unused original slots, kept all three feature-synchronization checks true, emitted all 29 requested batches of ten fresh valid molecules, retained 280 critic and 140 actor updates, and exited cleanly. Candidate and Parent used identical prepared-artifact content.

The evidence supports session-level reuse wherever a connected two-piece BRICS motif with inherited-compatible remaining ports can be extracted and receives nonzero sampling probability. It does not extend to objectives whose useful edits require non-BRICS rearrangement, ring closure, disconnected jumps, or motifs that the factorized actor and compatibility mask never select.

The trusted seed-0 summaries report Candidate macro score 0.444931622376474 versus Parent 0.432749830371344, a paired increase of 0.012181792005129977, but the per-task direction is mixed. This one replica supports activation plus aggregate utility under the frozen five-task, 300-call, batch-10 profile; it does not establish cross-seed reliability or isolate score causality from the changed sampled trajectories.

observable_measurements.name: goal_ranked_macrofragment_action_adoption
observable_measurements.parent_value: Parent n-ccfe8deb016a has a fixed 64-fragment vocabulary and no task-local promotion state or path. Its source contains no goal-macrofragment extraction, slot replacement, promotion, or adoption accounting, and its five seed-0 task logs contain zero fragment_sac_goal_macrofragment_promotion events, zero fragment_sac_goal_macrofragment_refresh events, zero promoted-slot ids in terminal provenance, and no goal_ranked_macrofragment_action_adoption fields in any of their 145 generation receipts. The registered Parent baseline is therefore exactly zero task-local promotions, zero emitted trajectories using a promoted action, zero promoted-action selections, and zero compressed primitive decisions.
observable_measurements.value: The formal seed-0 Candidate activated the registered mechanism in every Objective Session. Each task emitted 8 complete promotion receipts, with 2 initial promotions followed by 1 adaptive promotion after each of batches 1 through 6, so all sessions reached the bounded 8-of-64 dynamic slots by batch 6. Independent comparison with each task's trajectory JSONL found that all 40 promoted sources occur in the exact current-session score cohort named by the receipt, all 40 source scores and within-feedback ranks are exact, and every source is strictly above its cohort median; ranks span 1 through 5 of 10. All 40 receipts identify a canonical two-piece macrofragment, the replaced original fragment, 1 to 4 compatible open-port labels, 5 to 20 heavy atoms, three descriptor-nearest retained corpus actions, and true fragment-feature-buffer, port-feature-buffer, and action-feature synchronization. Every replaced original slot had zero recorded session use before replacement. Across all 145 suggestion batches and 1,450 emitted trajectories, 278 trajectories selected at least one currently promoted slot, an adoption fraction of 278/1450 = 0.1917241379310345; those trajectories made 358 promoted-slot selections and therefore compressed 358 primitive attachment decisions. Per task, zaleplon_mpo promoted 8 slots, used 8 of them, and recorded 97/290 adopting trajectories, 158 selections/compressed decisions, and 27/29 positive-adoption batches; deco_hop recorded 8 promotions, 8 used slots, 61/290 adopting trajectories, 70 selections/compressed decisions, and 23/29 positive batches; drd2_docking recorded 8 promotions, 6 used slots, 29/290 adopting trajectories, 34 selections/compressed decisions, and 19/29 positive batches; median_2 recorded 8 promotions, 8 used slots, 55/290 adopting trajectories, 58 selections/compressed decisions, and 23/29 positive batches; sitagliptin_mpo recorded 8 promotions, 7 used slots, 36/290 adopting trajectories, 38 selections/compressed decisions, and 20/29 positive batches. Thus 37 of 40 promoted slots were individually sampled, and every session satisfies the pre-registered activation requirement that at least one eligible above-median macrofragment be promoted and subsequently used. Reconstruction of all 1,450 terminal-provenance records exactly matches every batch adoption total, promoted slot id, promoted canonical structure, cumulative selection total, and cumulative compressed-decision total, with no mismatch.

possible_failure_causes: Adoption was positive in every task but not uniform across promoted actions: drd2_docking slots 58 and 59 and sitagliptin_mpo slot 58 were never selected, so 37 of 40 promoted slots contributed to the observed 358 selections. Compatibility, actor probability, and the early eight-slot cap can leave an individually valid promotion operationally dormant even when the session-level mechanism activates.

The selector is relative within each ten-molecule feedback cohort. It can promote a rank-5 molecule whose absolute score is weak when the whole cohort is weak; the formal run directly exercised ranks 1 through 5. Strict above-median rank establishes goal conditioning, but does not by itself establish that every admitted motif carries useful absolute objective signal.

All sessions filled the eight-slot allowance by adaptive batch 6 and never reconsidered those slots. Later feedback may contain stronger motifs that cannot enter after the cap, while early noisy or locally high-ranked motifs remain active for the rest of the session.

The compressed-decision quantity is a structural accounting identity of one saved primitive attachment per selected connected two-piece action. The replica has no paired route-level counterfactual constructing the same terminal molecule with the Parent vocabulary, so it does not establish how often that exact molecule was reachable, or how many failed sampling attempts were avoided, under primitive-only construction.

Activation and the positive aggregate score direction are observed only on screening seed 0. Independent-seed adoption stability, sensitivity to different initial score cohorts, and reliable score attribution remain unestablished; moreover, final Top-1 was higher than the Parent on deco_hop, drd2_docking, and sitagliptin_mpo but lower on zaleplon_mpo and median_2.

All sessions filled the eight-slot allowance by adaptive batch 6 and never reconsidered those slots. Later feedback may contain stronger motifs that cannot enter after the cap, while early noisy or locally high-ranked motifs remain active for the rest of the session.

The compressed-decision quantity is a structural accounting identity of one saved primitive attachment per selected connected two-piece action. The replica has no paired route-level counterfactual constructing the same terminal molecule with the Parent vocabulary, so it does not establish how often that exact molecule was reachable, or how many failed sampling attempts were avoided, under primitive-only construction.

Activation and the positive aggregate score direction are observed only on screening seed 0. Independent-seed adoption stability, sensitivity to different initial score cohorts, and reliable score attribution remain unestablished; moreover, final Top-1 was higher than the Parent on deco_hop, drd2_docking, and sitagliptin_mpo but lower on zaleplon_mpo and median_2.

activation_observables.measurement: For every Objective Session, emit a receipt for each promoted slot containing its canonical two-piece macrofragment, source molecule score and within-feedback rank, replaced original fragment, open-port labels, heavy-atom count, and synchronized actor-buffer state. For every suggestion batch report the number and fraction of emitted trajectories that selected at least one currently promoted slot and the cumulative primitive attachment decisions compressed by those selections. Compare the session totals with the Parent value of zero task-local promotions, zero promoted-action uses, and zero compressed decisions; activation requires at least one eligible above-median macrofragment to be promoted and subsequently used in an emitted trajectory.
activation_observables.name: goal_ranked_macrofragment_action_adoption

applicability_conditions: Task-local initial or adaptive feedback must contain score variation and at least one sanitizable molecule with a BRICS cut whose joined adjacent pieces form a novel proper subgraph with one to four remaining compatible ports; the Parent observed many distinct adaptive scores on every task.

The useful objective signal must be partly attributable to a connected two-piece BRICS motif and transferable when that motif is reused as a construction action; objectives requiring non-BRICS rearrangements, ring-closing actions, or disconnected jumps remain outside the claim.

The replacement remains bounded to eight of 64 slots and preserves the prepared actor dimensions, the inherited compatibility relation, validity and valence masks, uniform replay, twin-soft-Q and entropy objectives, direct sampling, and all evaluator protocol invariants.

A promoted macrofragment is an attachment-labelled subgraph action extracted only from molecules already scored in the current Objective Session; it is not a whole-molecule candidate, corpus retrieval result, extra oracle query, or cross-task memory.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism is falsified if eligible above-median scored molecules produce no admitted novel two-piece macrofragment, if admitted macrofragments are never selected in any emitted trajectory, or if a promotion receipt shows that the sampled slot still carries the replaced fragment's canonical structure, port descriptors, or action features rather than the promoted motif.
research_intent.implementation_change: At Objective Session initialization and after each observe, rank only the task-local scored molecules already supplied by the evaluator, enumerate their adjacent BRICS-piece pairs, and retain novel connected proper subgraphs with one to four compatible open ports and bounded heavy-atom size. Admit at most two initial macrofragments and then at most one per feedback boundary until eight total slots have been replaced; keep vocabulary tensor shapes fixed, choose the least-used unreplaced corpus slot, rebuild that slot's fragment and port descriptors, and initialize its actor embedding from descriptor-nearest retained corpus actions. Record promotion provenance and count promoted-slot use in generated trajectories while leaving behavior cloning artifacts, masks, SAC replay and losses, terminal reward placement, canonicalization, duplicate rejection, batch filling, and terminal shutdown unchanged.
research_intent.mechanism: Maintain the 64-action capacity but make up to eight slots task-local and goal-aware: promote canonical two-piece BRICS macrofragments extracted from above-median oracle-scored molecules into the lowest-use original vocabulary slots, so one sampled start or attachment action can reuse a scored connected motif that previously required two primitive fragment choices.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Algorithm Node n-a5a9c7e8871a established that the fixed 64-fragment action vocabulary represented 0 of 50 initial oracle observations and yielded only 10 complete corpus reconstruction routes, even though it filled every proposal batch with aggregate novel-valid yield 0.9843856076035302. Operational Parent n-ccfe8deb016a retained that same preparation and proposal mechanism and scored only 0.18878509058328807 on median_2 and 0.09619409434884696 on sitagliptin_mpo. The limiting behavior is therefore not failure to emit valid molecules, but a coarse static action alphabet that cannot expose task-relevant multi-fragment motifs from the scored molecules it observes.
